proof: The identity projection is among the coordinate projections.  The maximum effective VC radius over all projections is therefore at least the effective VC radius of $\mathcal{H}$ itself.
name: Projected VC Radius / Effective VC Radius
witness_verification: For the family #classes/universal_class with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
